verdict.rationale: Docs confirm data export via API and CSV for core entities (vendors, customers, bills, invoices, AP/AR payments), supporting portability in reasonably open formats. However, there's no explicit statement of full account/data export for platform migration or an all-encompassing 'leave the platform' export bundle. missing for 10: complete account-level export/backup guarantee, explicit open-standard (e.g., JSON/CSV schema) documentation for all data types, independent confirmation of unrestricted data portability.
